g.title: seq
g.text: 14f The budget of a barangay: who prepares, who enacts, who reviews

a.text: 1. Barangay to Barangay: Estimate of income
for the next year, and statements of income
and expenditure, on or before 15 September
2. Barangay: Prepare the budget with the
treasurer. Mandatory items: 10 percent of the
general fund for the youth council, at least
20 percent of the tax allotment for
development, 5 percent of regular income for
calamities. Personal services at most 55
percent of last year's income
3. Barangay to Barangay: Budget, on or before
16 October
4. Barangay: Appropriation ordinance, by a
majority of all members. The punong barangay
votes only when the votes are equal and has no
veto
5. Barangay to Local treasurer: Ordinance,
within 10 days after enactment
6. Local treasurer to Sanggunian: Ordinance
with findings
7. Sanggunian: Review within 60 days: legal
requirements and limits are met,
appropriations do not exceed estimated income
8. Sanggunian to Barangay: The ordinance is
deemed to be in full force
9. Sanggunian to Barangay: Returned for
adjustment. The treasurer may make no further
payments from the inoperative part
10. Barangay: Custody of the funds.
Collections and payments

a.xlink:title: end of: No action within 60 days
end of: Found inoperative, in whole or in part

a.text: 11. Barangay to Local treasurer: Records of
transactions. The accounts are kept in the
offices of the barangay treasurer and of the
city or municipal accountant
